model.name: The lobby WS does NOT reconnect-storm — the connection is stable, and the reconnect RATE is a VISIBLE signal so a storm cannot hide again
model.description: LIVE DEFECT (architect-diagnosed, Tron's screen): the lobby WS RECONNECTS every few seconds — this is the CONTINUOUS DRIVER that makes the room-list flap (BUG-lobby-roomlist-flap) visible + continuous. ★ MINTED AS ITS OWN REQUIREMENT, NOT folded into the flap fix (PO): the flap fix (A) removes the SYMPTOM (each reconnect re-sends the mixed list) and would HIDE this reconnect storm. This req = the WS connection is STABLE (no few-second reconnect loop; reconnects only on real network loss) AND the reconnect RATE is a VISIBLE signal (logged/surfaced/queryable) so a future storm SURFACES instead of hiding. Cause-fix = architect/expert; this states the WHAT.

discoverySource.evidence: LIVE: lobby WS reconnects every few seconds (continuous flap driver); minted separate per PO so A cannot hide B

model.crossRefNote: crossRef the room-list-flap req (A): B is the CONTINUOUS DRIVER of A's visible flap. A fixes the symptom; B must be measured/fixed INDEPENDENTLY (its gate measures reconnect RATE directly, never the room-list stability).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A stable lobby session does NOT reconnect on a few-second cadence — the WS stays connected and reconnects ONLY on a real network loss/close, not in a loop.

gateRef.ref: test WS stable session no reconnect loop
gateRef.assertion: over M seconds on a stable network the session reconnects 0 times (beyond the initial connect); N reconnects within a few seconds => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a session reconnecting every few seconds on a stable network -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ The reconnect RATE is a VISIBLE signal (a log line / metric / surfaced counter) so a reconnect storm CANNOT HIDE AGAIN — a reader or gate can observe the per-session reconnect rate directly.

gateRef.assertion: the reconnect rate/count is emitted as a queryable signal; a reconnect storm with NO visible rate signal => RED (it could hide)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a reconnect storm that produces NO visible reconnect-rate signal -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: This requirement is INDEPENDENT of the room-list-flap fix (A). Fixing A (the symptom) must NOT close B — B's gate measures the RECONNECT RATE directly, NEVER the room-list stability, so removing the visible flap does not falsely satisfy B.

gateRef.ref: test B measures reconnect rate not room-list
gateRef.assertion: B's satisfaction is decided by the measured reconnect rate; B marked satisfied via the room-list-flap being gone (without a reconnect-rate measure) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed B satisfied because A fixed the flap, with no reconnect-rate measurement -> RED
